about_short_description.short_description: Pyypl (pronounced as “people”) enables digital payments for the approaching 1 billion smartphone users in the Middle East and Africa.

product.name: Pyypl Digital Wallet App
product.description: A smartphone app providing access to digital financial services including money transfers, payments, and account management without requiring a bank account.

product.name: Pyypl Prepaid Visa Card
product.description: A prepaid Visa card linked to the Pyypl app for making online and in-store payments globally where Visa is accepted.

product.name: International Money Transfer Service
product.description: A service enabling users to send money instantly and securely to over 70 countries in multiple currencies via bank accounts, mobile wallets, or cash pickup.

product.name: Pyypl PayMe Link Payment Request
product.description: A feature that enables users to request payments from others via a simple link, facilitating easy receipt of funds within the app.
